h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Raipur

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Raipur

c: Raipur is hot for a large part of the year, so most people here exercise outdoors early in the morning or after sunset. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment for those hours, to parks, lakefronts, housing colonies, schools and industrial campuses in and around the city. We make our Fun Fitness machines at our factory in Vasai East, about 930 km away, and send them to Raipur by road.

Installation is done by our own team or a dealer, either grouted into the ground or on a self-standing base. Several kinds of Raipur site suit an open gym. Think of lake-side walkways such as the one at Telibandha, residential sectors in Nava Raipur, and the staff colonies of plants in the industrial areas around the city. Each needs a different mix of machines, and we plan that with you before anything is made.

richText.heading: Heat, dust and the monsoon in Chhattisgarh

c: Raipur's summer is fierce from April until the rains arrive, and the monsoon from June to September is heavy. Dust settles on equipment in the dry months, and rain then washes it into the moving parts. Wipe handles and pivots regularly, and check bearings once the monsoon ends.

Place the machines where a building or a row of trees throws shade in the early morning and evening, and set them on a slightly raised base so rainwater drains away. Galvanised frames carry our 3-year warranty, and bearings carry 1 year, as long as the equipment is installed and maintained as per our instructions.

c: A residential colony does not need a large budget to begin. items.q: Do you install outdoor gym equipment in Raipur and Nava Raipur?
items.a: Yes. We dispatch the machines from our Vasai factory by road and install them with our own team or a dealer, grouted or self-standing, depending on the ground at your site.

items.q: How should outdoor gym equipment be maintained in Raipur's dust?
items.a: Wipe handles and moving joints regularly in the dry months and inspect the bearings after the monsoon. We give you a maintenance checklist at handover, and following it keeps the warranty valid.

items.q: Can a college or company order a custom set of machines?
items.a: Yes. Tell us how many people will use the gym at one time and what kind of training they want. We will suggest a set of stations and show them on a layout drawing before you place the order.

items.q: What warranty do you offer on outdoor gym equipment?
items.a: Three years on galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts, and one year on springs, bearings and spare parts. It covers manufacturing defects when the equipment is installed and maintained as per our instructions.
